method.short: Paired on identical rows (9,975 checks). Intervals and tests are the leaderboard's: 2,000 group-bootstrap draws shared by both versions, 95% percentile interval of the difference, Wald test. A change is better or worse only when its Holm-adjusted p is below 0.05; otherwise it is within noise.
